title: A3 chunk transcript
description: One chunk's transcript at transcripts/<userId>/<jobId>/chunks/<chunk>.json in the uploads bucket. Producer: Whisper worker. Consumer: synthesis, which merges the chunks in order of chunk. Times are seconds from the start of the recording, not the chunk. Validate with transcripts.validate_transcript(body). Closed, so a new field means a schema change first.

startSeconds.description: Where the chunk starts in the recording (from the TranscriptionChunk message)

model.description: The checkpoint that produced it, e.g. distil-small.en

text.description: The segments' text joined with spaces; empty for a silent chunk
